releaseNotes:
LifeOS v3.3.5 (Build 72):
• LifeOS Drive & Docs Hub: 5.0 GB local-first cloud storage with high-speed multi-file uploads and instant cross-device QR code transfer
• In-Reader AI Document Inspector: Extracts and auto-routes document receipts, workouts, meals, notes, and tasks directly to LifeOS hubs
• Edge-to-Edge Android Layout: Refined status bar clearance, zero header overshadowing, and pinned ergonomic mobile action bars
• Enhanced Stability: Unified Nutrition split chip, secure deletion confirmation dialogs, and butter-smooth 120 FPS performance
